source.title: Londonderry Sentinel, 19 May 1949, p. 6 ("Contests in Tyrone and Londonderry")
source.publisher: Londonderry Sentinel (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: returned unopposed: the Sentinel's nominations list prints this candidate alone for the division and states there is one contest only, at Maghera (Londonderry Sentinel, 19 May 1949)

note: County and rural council elections were polled on 2 June 1949 (Belfast News-Letter, 3 June 1949: 'POLLING took place yesterday in the elections for county and rural councils in Northern Ireland'). Maghera was the only Londonderry County Council contest, the outgoing Nationalist William Noone being opposed by the Unionist James R. Crawford; all the other members were returned unopposed and are named in the Londonderry Sentinel's nominations list of 19 May 1949. Returned unopposed.
